### tool/vocabulary/corpus/2026-11-16-sonnet/answers/admin-console.txt ### Members
state tab="members"
state q=""
state roleFilter="All roles"
state statusFilter="All statuses"
state sortKey="name"
state sortDir="asc"
state selected=[]
state anchor=""
state focusId=""
state panelId=""
state panelW=380
state invites=[]
state inviteDraft=""
state inviteRole="Member"
state target=""
state bulkRole="Member"
state bulkTeam="Design"
state members=[{"id":"m1","name":"Ada Lindqvist","email":"ada@tenant.io","role":"Owner","teams":["Platform","Security"],"last":"2 min ago","status":"Active"},{"id":"m2","name":"Ben Okafor","email":"ben@tenant.io","role":"Admin","teams":["Platform"],"last":"1 h ago","status":"Active"},{"id":"m3","name":"Chloe Martin","email":"chloe@tenant.io","role":"Member","teams":["Design"],"last":"Yesterday","status":"Active"},{"id":"m4","name":"Dmitri Volkov","email":"dmitri@tenant.io","role":"Member","teams":["Data","Platform"],"last":"3 days ago","status":"Invited"},{"id":"m5","name":"Elena Rossi","email":"elena@tenant.io","role":"Billing","teams":["Finance"],"last":"Today","status":"Active"},{"id":"m6","name":"Farid Haddad","email":"farid@tenant.io","role":"Viewer","teams":[],"last":"6 weeks ago","status":"Deactivated"}]
state sessions=[{"id":"s1","device":"MacBook Pro, Chrome","where":"Oslo, NO","when":"Active now"},{"id":"s2","device":"iPhone 15, App","where":"Oslo, NO","when":"2 h ago"},{"id":"s3","device":"Windows, Edge","where":"Bergen, NO","when":"5 days ago"}]
state activity=[{"id":"a1","text":"Changed role to Admin","when":"Mon"},{"id":"a2","text":"Added to Platform","when":"Mon"},{"id":"a3","text":"Signed in from a new device","when":"Last week"}]
state all=["Platform","Security","Design","Data","Finance","Support"]
state panelRole=""
Shortcut keys="/" onPress={focus search}
Shortcut keys="ctrl+a" onPress={selected=map(filter(members,m=>true),m=>m.id)}
Shortcut keys="escape" onPress={selected=[]; panelId=""}
Shortcut keys="ctrl+i" onPress={open invite}
App
  Sidebar
    Brand "Tenant" icon="hub"
    NavItem "Members" icon="group" badge="50" selected={tab=="members"} onTap={go members}
    NavItem "Roles" icon="admin_panel_settings" onTap={go roles}
    NavItem "Teams" icon="groups" onTap={go teams}
    NavItem "Audit log" icon="history" onTap={go audit-log}
    NavItem "Billing" icon="credit_card" onTap={go billing}
    NavItem "API keys" icon="key" onTap={go api-keys}
    NavItem "Settings" icon="settings" onTap={go settings}
    Spacer grow
    Row gap=8 middle
      Avatar "Ada Lindqvist" size=32
      Text.muted "Ada Lindqvist"
  Main
    Nav
      Heading "Members" level=1
      Row gap=8
        Input#search "Search members" "Name or email" @q w=240 icon="search" fuzzy
        Button "Invite" icon="person_add" onTap={open invite}
        Text.caption "Ctrl+I" hide=tablet
    Row grow
      Column grow gap=12 pad=24 scroll
        Row gap=8 wrap
          Select "Role" @roleFilter items=["All roles","Owner","Admin","Member","Billing","Viewer"]
          Select "Status" @statusFilter items=["All statuses","Active","Invited","Deactivated"]
          Spacer grow
          Text.muted "{length(filter(members,m=>(roleFilter=='All roles'||m.role==roleFilter)&&(statusFilter=='All statuses'||m.status==statusFilter)&&fuzzy(m.name+' '+m.email,q)))} of 50 members"
        if length(selected)>0
          Box fill=#FFE8F0FE radius=8 pad=12 live=polite
            Row between middle gap=12
              Text.strong "{length(selected)} selected"
              Row gap=8 wrap
                Select "Change role" @bulkRole items=["Owner","Admin","Member","Billing","Viewer"] onChange={members=updateWhere(members,m=>contains(selected,m.id),m=>with(m,"role",result)); announce "Role changed to {result} for {length(selected)} members"; toast "Role changed for {length(selected)} members"}
                Button.outline "Add to team" icon="group_add" onTap={open bulkTeam}
                Button.destructive "Deactivate" onTap={open confirmDeactivate}
                Button.ghost "Clear" onTap={selected=[]}
        Table rows={sortDir=="asc"?sortBy(filter(members,m=>(roleFilter=="All roles"||m.role==roleFilter)&&(statusFilter=="All statuses"||m.status==statusFilter)&&fuzzy(m.name+" "+m.email,q)),m=>m[sortKey]):sortByDesc(filter(members,m=>(roleFilter=="All roles"||m.role==roleFilter)&&(statusFilter=="All statuses"||m.status==statusFilter)&&fuzzy(m.name+" "+m.email,q)),m=>m[sortKey])} dense sticky-header selectable multi selected=@selected onRowTap={panelId=result.id} onSelect={selected=result.ids} rowKey=id
          Column "Name" key=name sortable w=200 onSort={sortKey="name"; sortDir=sortDir=="asc"?"desc":"asc"}
          Column "Email" key=email sortable w=220 onSort={sortKey="email"; sortDir=sortDir=="asc"?"desc":"asc"}
          Column "Role" key=role sortable w=100 onSort={sortKey="role"; sortDir=sortDir=="asc"?"desc":"asc"}
          Column "Teams" w=200
          Column "Last active" key=last sortable w=120 onSort={sortKey="last"; sortDir=sortDir=="asc"?"desc":"asc"}
          Column "Status" key=status sortable w=110 onSort={sortKey="status"; sortDir=sortDir=="asc"?"desc":"asc"}
          Column "" w=48
      if panelId!=""
        Splitter @panelW min=300 max=560 side=right label="Resize member panel"
        Pane w={panelW} pad=16 gap=12 scroll
          Row between middle
            Heading "Member" level=3
            IconButton "close" tooltip="Close panel" onTap={panelId=""}
          Row gap=12 middle
            Avatar "{find(members,m=>m.id==panelId).name}" size=48
            Column gap=2
              Text.strong "{find(members,m=>m.id==panelId).name}"
              Text.muted "{find(members,m=>m.id==panelId).email}"
          Select "Role" @panelRole items=["Owner","Admin","Member","Billing","Viewer"] onChange={members=updateWhere(members,m=>m.id==panelId,m=>with(m,"role",result)); announce "Role saved"; toast "Role saved"}
          Text.sectionTitle "Teams"
          each t in all
            Checkbox "{t}" checked={contains(find(members,m=>m.id==panelId).teams,t)} onChange={members=updateWhere(members,m=>m.id==panelId,m=>with(m,"teams",result?append(m.teams,t):without(m.teams,t)))}
          Divider
          Text.sectionTitle "Sessions"
          each s in sessions
            Row between middle gap=8
              Column grow gap=2
                Text.strong "{s.device}"
                Text.caption "{s.where} · {s.when}"
              Button.outline "Revoke" size=small onTap={sessions=removeWhere(sessions,x=>x.id==s.id); announce "Session revoked"; toast "Session revoked"}
          Divider
          Text.sectionTitle "Activity"
          each a in activity
            Row between
              Text "{a.text}"
              Text.caption "{a.when}"
  Dialog#invite "Invite members" "Separate emails with a comma or Enter"
    ChipInput "Emails" @invites draft=inviteDraft separators=[",",";"," "] validate="email" hint="name@company.com" onInvalid={announce "Not a valid email"}
    Select "Role" @inviteRole items=["Admin","Member","Billing","Viewer"]
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={invites=[]; close}
      Button "Send {length(invites)} invites" disabled={length(invites)==0||any(invites,i=>!i.valid)} onTap={emit invite {"emails":invites,"role":inviteRole}; toast "{length(invites)} invitations sent"; announce "Invitations sent"; invites=[]; close}
  Dialog#confirmDeactivate "Deactivate {length(selected)} members?" "They lose access immediately. Their data is kept."
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
      Button.destructive "Deactivate {length(selected)}" onTap={members=updateWhere(members,m=>contains(selected,m.id),m=>with(m,"status","Deactivated")); announce "{length(selected)} members deactivated"; toast "{length(selected)} members deactivated"; selected=[]; close}
  Dialog#bulkTeam "Add {length(selected)} members to a team"
    Select "Team" @bulkTeam items=["Platform","Security","Design","Data","Finance","Support"]
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
      Button "Add" onTap={members=updateWhere(members,m=>contains(selected,m.id),m=>with(m,"teams",unique(append(m.teams,bulkTeam)))); toast "Added to {bulkTeam}"; announce "Added to {bulkTeam}"; close}
  Menu#rowMenu end
    MenuItem "Open profile" icon="person" onTap={panelId=target}
    MenuItem "Change role" icon="badge" onTap={open roleDialog}
    MenuItem "Resend invite" icon="mail" onTap={toast "Invite resent"}
    MenuItem "Deactivate" icon="block" danger onTap={selected=[target]; open confirmDeactivate}

### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b08/answers/lab-instrument.txt ### Samples
state tab="samples"
state selected=[]
state metric="Absorbance"
state wells=[{"id":"A1","v":0.12},{"id":"A2","v":0.34},{"id":"A3","v":0.58},{"id":"A4","v":0.81},{"id":"B1","v":0.15},{"id":"B2","v":0.39},{"id":"B3","v":0.62},{"id":"B4","v":0.88},{"id":"C1","v":0.09},{"id":"C2","v":0.31},{"id":"C3","v":0.55},{"id":"C4","v":0.74}]
state combined=false
App
  Sidebar
    Brand "Spectra Bench" icon="graphic_eq"
    NavItem "Spectrum" icon="show_chart" selected={tab=="spectrum"} onTap={go spectrum}
    NavItem "Samples" icon="grid_view" selected={tab=="samples"} onTap={go samples}
    NavItem "Calibrate" icon="tune" selected={tab=="calibrate"} onTap={go calibrate}
    Spacer grow
    Text.muted "Bench 2, Lamp D2"
  Main
    Nav
      Heading "Sample plate" level=1
      Row gap=8
        SegmentedButton items=["Absorbance","Fluorescence"] @metric
        Button "Combine selected" icon="merge" onTap={length(selected)>1 ? combined=true : toast "Select at least two wells"}
    Column pad=24 gap=16 scroll
      Row gap=16 top
        Card grow gap=12
          Row between
            Heading "Wells" level=3
            Text.muted "{length(selected)} selected"
          Grid cols=4 gap=8
            each w in wells
              Box pad=12 radius=8 fill={w.v>0.7 ? "#FFC62828" : w.v>0.45 ? "#FFEF6C00" : w.v>0.2 ? "#FF2E7D32" : "#FF1565C0"} onTap={selected=contains(selected,w.id) ? without(selected,w.id) : append(selected,w.id)} menu=wellMenu
                Row between
                  Text.strong "{w.id}" color=#FFFFFFFF
                  Icon "check_circle" color=#FFFFFFFF visible={contains(selected,w.id)}
                Text "{fixed(w.v,2)}" color=#FFFFFFFF size=20
          Row gap=12
            Badge.info "Low"
            Badge.success "Mid"
            Badge.warning "High"
            Badge.error "Saturated"
        Card w=360 gap=12
          Heading "Combined curve" level=3
          if combined
            LineChart series={map(selected,id=>{"name":id,"values":[find(wells,x=>x.id==id).v*0.4,find(wells,x=>x.id==id).v*0.8,find(wells,x=>x.id==id).v]})} labels=["400","550","700"] h=220
            Text.muted "Mean reading {fixed(sum(selected,id=>find(wells,x=>x.id==id).v)/length(selected),2)}"
            Button.outline "Clear" onTap={combined=false; selected=[]}
          if !combined
            Text.muted "Pick wells on the left, then combine them into one curve."
          Divider
          Table items={wells} columns=["id","v"] headers=["Well","Reading"] h=200
  Menu#wellMenu
    MenuItem "Select row" icon="select_all" onTap={selected=map(filter(wells,x=>startsWith(x.id,"A")),x=>x.id)}
    MenuItem "Clear selection" icon="deselect" onTap={selected=[]}

      Row gap=16 top
        Card grow gap=12
          Row between

              Badge.info "Men"
              Badge.primary "Women"
          PopulationPyramid data={ages} ageKey="age" leftKey="m" rightKey="f" leftLabel="Men" rightLabel="Women" h=360 onSelect={emit pickAge result}

          AreaChart labels=["1970","1980","1990","2000","2010","2020"] values=[556667,562647,583887,660486,735334,815428] h=360
      Card gap=8
        Text.strong "What is notable"
        Text.body "More than a third of residents are between 20 and 39, and women outnumber men in every band from 50 up."
      Card gap=8
        Row between
          Text.strong "Numbers by age"
          Button.tertiary "Download table" icon="download" onTap={emit download "age-table.csv"}
        Table rows={sortDir=="asc" ? sortBy(ages, r=>r[sortCol]) : sortByDesc(ages, r=>r[sortCol])} sort={sortCol} dir={sortDir} onSort={sortCol=result.column; sortDir=result.dir}
          Column "age" "Age" w=90
          Column "m" "Men" w=120 align=right
          Column "f" "Women" w=120 align=right
          Column "total" "Total" grow align=right
  Dialog#pickSecond "Compare with" "Choose a second place"
    Input "Search places" @second
    each p in filter(["Washington County, OR","Clackamas County, OR","Lane County, OR","King County, WA","Cook County, IL"], x=>contains(lower(x), lower(second)))
      ListTile "{p}" icon="place" onTap={other=p; close; go compare}

### docs/reference/notation/lists.md block 10
state orders=[{"id":"o1","name":"Ada Byron","status":"Paid","total":30},{"id":"o2","name":"Lin Chen","status":"Due","total":12}]
state search=""
state status="All"
state sortKey="name"
state chosen=[]
state shown:list={filter(orders, r => (status == 'All' || r.status == status) && contains(lower(r.name), lower(search)))}
Page
  Section
    Row gap=8
      Input "" "Search" @search w=280
      Select @status items=["All","Paid","Due"] w=140
    Table#orders o in shown columns=[{"key":"name","label":"Customer"},{"key":"status","label":"Status","w":120},{"key":"total","label":"Total","w":100,"align":"end"}] sort=@sortKey select=@chosen empty="No orders match."
      Row gap=10
        Avatar "AB" size=28
        Text.strong "{o.name}"
      Badge "{o.status}"
